description: This file contains the implementation of the SeoUrl class within the Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Startup namespace. It extends the system engine Controller and provides methods to handle URL rewriting and SEO-friendly URL decoding for the OpenCart project's catalog startup process.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling SEO URL rewriting and decoding in the catalog startup process of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes URL rewriting by adding rewrite rules if SEO URLs are enabled and decodes incoming SEO URLs into route parameters.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Converts a standard URL into its SEO-friendly form by parsing and rebuilding the URL with SEO keywords.
